package handlers

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/task"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
)

const diagnosticCourseID = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"

type diagnosticLessonReader struct {
	lessons []domain.Lesson
	err     error
	calls   int
}

func (r *diagnosticLessonReader) ListByCourse(context.Context, string) ([]domain.Lesson, error) {
	r.calls++
	return r.lessons, r.err
}

type diagnosticTaskReader struct {
	tasks map[string][]domain.Task
	err   error
	calls int
}

func (r *diagnosticTaskReader) ListByLesson(_ context.Context, id string) ([]domain.Task, error) {
	r.calls++
	return r.tasks[id], r.err
}

func serveDiagnostic(t *testing.T, handler *TaskHandler, courseID, token string) *httptest.ResponseRecorder {
	t.Helper()
	r := chi.NewRouter()
	r.Get("/course/{courseID}", handler.GetInternalDiagnosticAssessments)
	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/course/"+courseID, nil)
	if token != "" {
		req.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", token)
	}
	resp := httptest.NewRecorder()
	r.ServeHTTP(resp, req)
	return resp
}

func TestGetInternalDiagnosticAssessmentsValidationAndDependencyStatus(t *testing.T) {
	lessons := &diagnosticLessonReader{}
	handler := &TaskHandler{GetInternalCourseStructureUC: task.GetInternalCourseStructure{Lessons: lessons, Tasks: &diagnosticTaskReader{}}}
	resp := serveDiagnostic(t, handler, "not-a-uuid", "")
	if resp.Code != http.StatusBadRequest || lessons.calls != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("malformed course: status=%d calls=%d", resp.Code, lessons.calls)
	}
	resp = serveDiagnostic(t, &TaskHandler{}, diagnosticCourseID, "")
	if resp.Code != http.StatusInternalServerError {
		t.Fatalf("unconfigured dependencies: status=%d", resp.Code)
	}
}

func TestGetInternalDiagnosticAssessmentsMapsNotFoundAndBound(t *testing.T) {
	lessons := &diagnosticLessonReader{err: domain.ErrNotFound}
	handler := &TaskHandler{GetInternalCourseStructureUC: task.GetInternalCourseStructure{Lessons: lessons, Tasks: &diagnosticTaskReader{}}}
	if resp := serveDiagnostic(t, handler, diagnosticCourseID, ""); resp.Code != http.StatusNotFound {
		t.Fatalf("not found status=%d", resp.Code)
	}
	activeTasks := make([]domain.Task, 101)
	for i := range activeTasks {
		activeTasks[i] = domain.Task{ID: strings.Repeat("a", 31) + string(rune('a'+i%26)), Type: domain.TaskTypeTest, Status: domain.TaskStatusActive, AssessmentPurpose: domain.AssessmentPurposeDiagnostic, EvaluationMode: domain.TaskEvaluationModeAuto}
	}
	lessons = &diagnosticLessonReader{lessons: []domain.Lesson{{ID: "lesson", Status: domain.LessonStatusActive}}}
	tasks := &diagnosticTaskReader{tasks: map[string][]domain.Task{"lesson": activeTasks}}
	handler = &TaskHandler{GetInternalCourseStructureUC: task.GetInternalCourseStructure{Lessons: lessons, Tasks: tasks}}
	if resp := serveDiagnostic(t, handler, diagnosticCourseID, ""); resp.Code != http.StatusUnprocessableEntity {
		t.Fatalf("bound status=%d", resp.Code)
	}
}

func TestGetInternalDiagnosticAssessmentsSuccessIsVersionedAndPrivate(t *testing.T) {
	lessons := &diagnosticLessonReader{lessons: []domain.Lesson{{ID: "lesson", Status: domain.LessonStatusActive}}}
	tasks := &diagnosticTaskReader{tasks: map[string][]domain.Task{"lesson": {{ID: "task", LessonID: "lesson", Type: domain.TaskTypeOrdering, Status: domain.TaskStatusActive, Version: 4, AssessmentPurpose: domain.AssessmentPurposeDiagnostic, EvaluationMode: domain.TaskEvaluationModeAuto, LearningTargets: []domain.TaskLearningTarget{{Type: domain.LearningTargetConcept, Key: "go.types", Version: "v1"}}}}}}
	handler := &TaskHandler{GetInternalCourseStructureUC: task.GetInternalCourseStructure{Lessons: lessons, Tasks: tasks}}
	resp := serveDiagnostic(t, handler, diagnosticCourseID, "")
	if resp.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("success status=%d body=%s", resp.Code, resp.Body.String())
	}
	var payload map[string]any
	if err := json.Unmarshal(resp.Body.Bytes(), &payload); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if payload["schema"] != task.DiagnosticAssessmentCatalogSchema {
		t.Fatalf("schema=%v", payload["schema"])
	}
	raw := resp.Body.String()
	for _, forbidden := range []string{"\"tests\"", "is_correct", "correct_order", "group_id", "code_structure"} {
		if strings.Contains(raw, forbidden) {
			t.Fatalf("private field %q leaked: %s", forbidden, raw)
		}
	}
}

func TestGetInternalDiagnosticAssessmentsRejectsNonAutoEvaluationModes(t *testing.T) {
	lessons := &diagnosticLessonReader{lessons: []domain.Lesson{{ID: "lesson", Status: domain.LessonStatusActive}}}
	for _, evaluationMode := range []int16{domain.TaskEvaluationModeManual, domain.TaskEvaluationModeHybrid, 99} {
		t.Run(domain.TaskEvaluationModeName(evaluationMode), func(t *testing.T) {
			tasks := &diagnosticTaskReader{tasks: map[string][]domain.Task{"lesson": {{
				ID: "task", LessonID: "lesson", Type: domain.TaskTypeTest, Status: domain.TaskStatusActive,
				AssessmentPurpose: domain.AssessmentPurposeDiagnostic, EvaluationMode: evaluationMode,
			}}}}
			handler := &TaskHandler{GetInternalCourseStructureUC: task.GetInternalCourseStructure{Lessons: lessons, Tasks: tasks}}
			if resp := serveDiagnostic(t, handler, diagnosticCourseID, ""); resp.Code != http.StatusUnprocessableEntity {
				t.Fatalf("evaluation mode %d should fail closed with 422, got %d", evaluationMode, resp.Code)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestGetInternalDiagnosticAssessmentsUnexpectedDependencyErrorIs500(t *testing.T) {
	handler := &TaskHandler{GetInternalCourseStructureUC: task.GetInternalCourseStructure{Lessons: &diagnosticLessonReader{err: errors.New("db")}, Tasks: &diagnosticTaskReader{}}}
	if resp := serveDiagnostic(t, handler, diagnosticCourseID, ""); resp.Code != http.StatusInternalServerError {
		t.Fatalf("status=%d", resp.Code)
	}
}
